reason: The README provides clear evidence of a single primary purpose: improving DSH web search reliability by pooling multiple backends and handling provider failover/rotation with quota-aware circuit breaking. It also documents user-facing settings and status features for search providers, confirming this is a search-browsing utility centered on external search provider orchestration.

summaries.zh: 该插件提供 DSH 的 provider 级搜索池，在保持原生 web_search 的同时，在多个搜索后端间按策略执行自动切换与轮询，并支持后端状态与密钥的本地配置管理。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a DSH provider-level search pool that keeps native web_search behavior and automatically handles search requests across multiple backends with configurable failover or rotation, plus local settings for backend keys and status.

capabilities: Routes web searches through multiple external search backends with failover or rotate strategies
Applies circuit-breaking behavior based on quota and transient failures
Supports local storage of provider keys and runtime configuration from settings/UI
Exposes local endpoints to update keys, reset config, and inspect provider state
Provides an optional explicit search tool for selecting a source
